$laws_comment: The primary constitutional laws. Their normative home is CEP-009 ADDENDUM B; this section
records the located basis each law derives from so that the law is never orphaned.

laws.law: The constitutional foundation shall not require redesign for the introduction of any future constitutional construct.
Future evolution shall occur through constitutional registration, integration, governance, validation, certification and traceability, never through architectural replacement of the foundation.
An apparent requirement for foundational redesign is a defect of the introduction, not of the foundation, and is recorded as a finiteness risk rather than remedied by redesign.
The corpus supports unlimited constitutional evolution; any future construct may be introduced at any time.
The register of admissible construct classes shall never be assumed complete; a class absent from it is admitted by the same procedure and its absence is no ground of rejection.
Expansion shall not be achieved by reinterpretation of an existing member to mean something new; reinterpretation is invisible to validation and admission is visible.
Architectural redesign shall never be a stage of the evolution lifecycle; a traversal requiring it has failed at reuse or dependency analysis and is returned there.
The framework introduces no lifecycle; every stage is owned elsewhere and consumed by reference, and is void as to any stage lacking a located owner.
No finite architectural boundary shall exist; expansion is unbounded in count along every declared axis.
The only bound upon growth is evidence; it bounds legitimacy and never quantity, and shall not be cited as a finite ceiling.
A property whose discharging mechanism cannot be located is not satisfied; absence of evidence is not evidence of satisfaction.
Repository Truth is the sole implementation authority; a derived measurement holds no authority over constitutional content.

$stages_comment: The canonical constitutional evolution lifecycle of CEP-009 ADDENDUM B B.4.1. Each entry
BINDS a stage to the located owner that already performs it. `owner` MUST resolve against
Repository Truth and MUST lie outside this programme's own home, otherwise the stage would
be authored here rather than bound — the duplication B.4.3 forbids. `depends_on` names only
earlier declared stages, so the graph is acyclic, totally ordered and closed.

stages.purpose: Establish that the concept is not already owned, naming every existing owner examined and why each is insufficient.
Assimilate the presented context into the corpus as a governed decision with exactly one lawful disposition.
Resolve the constitutional and artifact state of the repository as the sole implementation authority.
Prefer extension over creation and creation over modification; bind to the existing owner wherever one exists.
Determine the artifacts, lineages, dependencies and compatibility affected, and verify the graph remains acyclic.
Allocate the concept to exactly one owner, declare its relationships, and admit it to the registry with identity, kind, standing, reach and state.
Admit any required ontology entity as an append operation without altering an existing cardinality.
Admit any required Kind as an append operation to the open Kind set without amending an existing Kind.
Regenerate every derived projection in one atomic transaction so the registry is recomputable and free of drift.
Verify the change under governance change control and re-run the meta validator so all twelve invariants hold.
Catalogue the capability so it becomes executable, and order it against its dependencies.
Realize the capability under the universal implementation contract, additively and within declared write scope.
Run every mandatory validation gate; a failure blocks progression rather than being waived.
Issue the certification determination on evidence, at PROVISIONAL standing where the competent authority is vacant.
Record the evolution, its classification, its lineage and its state, so the corpus has grown by governed evolution.

$construct_register_comment: The construct-class register is OPEN. `closed` MUST remain false: a true value would assert
a finite ceiling, which CMG-000001 LXXVI.5 declares a defect. The engine names no class, so
admitting a further class is an append to `construct_classes` and requires no code change.

construct_register.unknown_class_disposition: A construct class absent from this register is admitted by the same procedure as one present in it. Its absence SHALL NOT be cited as a ground of rejection.

$axes_comment: The open-world expansion axes. `bounded` MUST be false for every axis: a bounded axis is a
declared finite ceiling and is a defect under CMG-000001 LXXVI.5.
$criteria_comment: The architectural acceptance criteria of CEP-009 ADDENDUM B B.6.1. `mechanism` MUST resolve
against Repository Truth and MUST lie outside this programme's home; an unlocated mechanism

criteria.criterion: Require no redesign of the constitutional foundation

$governance_comment: One obligation per constitutional operation named at CEP-009 ADDENDUM B B.2.2, plus the
prohibition of redesign. `instrument` MUST resolve; `enforced_by` MUST name a declared stage.
An obligation whose instrument cannot be located governs nothing and does not discharge.

governance.obligation: Every introduced construct is registered before it is relied upon; an unregistered construct is deemed non-existent.
Every introduced construct is integrated into ontology and taxonomy by append, never by alteration of an existing member.
Every introduced construct is governed by exactly one located authority; parallel authority is prohibited.
Every introduced construct is validated before progression; validation is never waived, deferred or overridden.
Every introduced construct is certified on evidence, at PROVISIONAL standing while the competent authority is vacant.
Every introduced construct closes its traceability; an introduction whose traceability cannot be closed is void.
Reuse is analysed before creation and creation before modification; a construct that duplicates an existing owner is refused.
Architectural redesign is never adopted as an ordinary evolution route; it proceeds only as a MAJOR modification or as supersession with lineage.
Context is assimilated as a governed decision holding exactly one lawful disposition before anything is built.
Repository Truth is resolved before disposition, and prevails over any derived record on divergence.
A construct is discovered against every existing owner before creation is contemplated.
Derived projections are regenerated atomically so the registry remains recomputable and drift-free.
Only a catalogued capability executes; implementation proceeds under the universal implementation contract.
Implementation is additive and confined to declared write scope; frozen and certified zones are never mutated.
Any required ontology entity is admitted without altering an existing cardinality.
Every evolution is recorded with its classification, lineage and state; an unrecorded amendment is deemed non-existent.

$validations_comment: The mandatory validation dimensions. `probe` binds the dimension to the generic computation
the engine performs; `verified_by` names the located artifact the computation reads. A
dimension whose probe cannot be computed yields UNVERIFIED, and UNVERIFIED is fail-closed:

validations.dimension: No expansion axis declares a finite bound
Every lifecycle stage is bound to a located owner
Every acceptance criterion is discharged by a located mechanism
Every law is anchored to a located basis
Every governance obligation names a located instrument and a declared stage
The normative home records the framework
The Constitution Registry records the amended version of the normative home

$exit_criteria_comment: The success criteria of the mission. `satisfied_by` names the validation dimensions whose
conjunction satisfies the criterion; every named dimension MUST be declared.

exit_criteria.criterion: The repository possesses a permanent constitutional capability whereby any future construct can be introduced through governed evolution without modification or redesign of the constitutional foundation.
Growth occurs through constitutional evolution and never through architectural redesign.
Repository Truth remains the single constitutional authority; no competing authority is created.
The principle is institutionalized in the instrument that owns evolution.
The principle is traceable end to end with zero orphans.
The principle is validated by executed measurement rather than assertion.
The principle is certified, and certification is withheld where any dimension is unsatisfied.
The principle is integrated throughout the repository: governance, registration, ontology, taxonomy, registry, dependency, validation, certification and traceability each participate.
